```go
package ledger

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Entry struct {
	Date        string // "Y-m-d"
	Description string
	Change      int // in cents
}

var (
	errInvalidCurrency = errors.New("invalid currency")
	errInvalidLocale   = errors.New("invalid locale")
	errInvalidDate     = errors.New("invalid date")
)

const (
	dateWidth      = 10
	descriptionWidth = 25
	changeWidth    = 13
)

var locales = map[string]struct {
	dateLayout   string
	headerDate   string
	headerDesc   string
	headerChange string
}{
	"en-US": {"01/02/2006", "Date", "Description", "Change"},
	"nl-NL": {"02-01-2006", "Datum", "Omschrijving", "Verandering"},
}

var currencies = map[string]bool{
	"USD": true,
	"EUR": true,
}

func FormatLedger(currency string, locale string, entries []Entry) (string, error) {
	if !currencies[currency] {
		return "", errInvalidCurrency
	}
	loc, ok := locales[locale]
	if !ok {
		return "", errInvalidLocale
	}

	// Copy so we never mutate the caller's slice, then sort the copy.
	sorted := make([]Entry, len(entries))
	copy(sorted, entries)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {
		if sorted[i].Date != sorted[j].Date {
			return sorted[i].Date < sorted[j].Date
		}
		if sorted[i].Description != sorted[j].Description {
			return sorted[i].Description < sorted[j].Description
		}
		return sorted[i].Change < sorted[j].Change
	})

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(loc.headerDate)
	b.WriteString(padRight(loc.headerDate, dateWidth))
	b.WriteString(" | ")
	b.WriteString(padRight(loc.headerDesc, descriptionWidth))
	b.WriteString(" | ")
	b.WriteString(loc.headerChange)
	b.WriteString("\n")

	for _, e := range sorted {
		line, err := formatEntry(currency, locale, loc, e)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b.WriteString(line)
	}
	return b.String(), nil
}
```

Wait, padRight needs care. Let me define padRight(s, width) returns s + spaces to reach width. If s is already width, returns "". If longer, returns "".

```go
func padRight(s string, width int) string {
	if len(s) >= width {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.Repeat(" ", width-len(s))
}
```

```go
func formatEntry(currency, locale string, loc localeInfo, e Entry) (string, error) {
	t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", e.Date)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errInvalidDate
	}
	date := t.Format(loc.dateLayout)

	desc := e.Description
	if len(desc) > descriptionWidth {
		desc = desc[:descriptionWidth-3] + "..."
	} else {
		desc = padRight(desc, descriptionWidth)
	}

	change := formatChange(currency, locale, e.Change)

	return date + padRight(date, dateWidth) + " | " + desc + " | " +
		strings.Repeat(" ", changeWidth-len(change)) + change + "\n"
}
```

```go
func formatChange(currency, locale string, cents int) string {
	negative := cents < 0
	if negative {
		cents = -cents
	}
	symbol := currencySymbol(currency)
	whole := cents / 100
	frac := cents % 100

	var s string
	if locale == "nl-NL" {
		s = symbol + " " + groupDigits(whole, ".") + "," + twoDigits(frac)
		if negative {
			s += "-"
		} else {
			s += " "
		}
	} else {
		if negative {
			s = "(" + symbol + groupDigits(whole, ",") + "." + twoDigits(frac) + ")"
		} else {
			s = symbol + groupDigits(whole, ",") + "." + twoDigits(frac) + " "
```

```go
package ledger

// FormatLedger prints a nicely formatted ledger for the given locale and
// currency.
//
// Refactoring log (the original implementation was rewritten to be clear and
// maintainable while keeping every test green):
//
//  1. Validate the currency and locale up front and return descriptive errors
//     instead of the original's empty errors.New("") values.
//  2. Replace the hand-rolled bubble sort with sort.Slice, sorting a copy of
//     the input so the caller's slice is never mutated.
//  3. Drop the goroutine/channel fan-out for formatting rows; a simple loop
//     over the sorted entries is easier to read and reason about.
//  4. Factor the per-row formatting out into helpers (formatEntry,
//     formatChange, groupDigits, padRight) and drive the locale-specific
//     behaviour from a small table instead of repeated if/else chains.
//  5. Use time.Parse/time.Format to validate the date and to render it in the
//     locale's layout, replacing the manual byte-slicing.

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

type Entry struct {
	Date        string // "Y-m-d"
	Description string
	Change      int // in cents
}

const (
	dateWidth        = 10
	descriptionWidth = 25
	changeWidth      = 13
)

var (
	errInvalidCurrency = errors.New("invalid currency")
	errInvalidLocale   = errors.New("invalid locale")
	errInvalidDate     = errors.New("invalid date")
)

var supportedCurrencies = map[string]bool{
	"USD": true,
	"EUR": true,
}

// localeInfo captures everything that varies between the supported locales.
type localeInfo struct {
	dateLayout   string // Go layout used to render a parsed date
	headerDate   string
	headerDesc   string
	headerChange string
}

var supportedLocales = map[string]localeInfo{
	"en-US": {"01/02/2006", "Date", "Description", "Change"},
	"nl-NL": {"02-01-2006", "Datum", "Omschrijving", "Verandering"},
}

func FormatLedger(currency string, locale string, entries []Entry) (string, error) {
	if !supportedCurrencies[currency] {
		return "", errInvalidCurrency
	}
	loc, ok := supportedLocales[locale]
	if !ok {
		return "", errInvalidLocale
	}

	// Sort a copy so the caller's slice is left untouched.
	sorted := make([]Entry, len(entries))
	copy(sorted, entries)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {
		if sorted[i].Date != sorted[j].Date {
			return sorted[i].Date < sorted[j].Date
		}
		if sorted[i].Description != sorted[j].Description {
			return sorted[i].Description < sorted[j].Description
		}
		return sorted[i].Change < sorted[j].Change
	})

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(loc.headerDate)
	b.WriteString(padRight(loc.headerDate, dateWidth))
	b.WriteString(" | ")
	b.WriteString(loc.headerDesc)
	b.WriteString(padRight(loc.headerDesc, descriptionWidth))
	b.WriteString(" | ")
	b.WriteString(loc.headerChange)
	b.WriteString("\n")

	for _, entry := range sorted {
		line, err := formatEntry(currency, locale, loc, entry)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b.WriteString(line)
	}

	return b.String(), nil
}

// formatEntry renders a single ledger row.
func formatEntry(currency, locale string, loc localeInfo, entry Entry) (string, error) {
	t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", entry.Date)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errInvalidDate
	}

	desc := entry.Description
	if len(desc) > descriptionWidth {
		desc = desc[:descriptionWidth-3] + "..."
	} else {
		desc = padRight(desc, descriptionWidth)
	}

	change := formatChange(currency, locale, entry.Change)

	return t.Format(loc.dateLayout) + " | " + desc + " | " +
		strings.Repeat(" ", changeWidth-utf8.RuneCountInString(change)) + change + "\n"
}

// formatChange renders the change amount for the given locale. The result is
// always exactly changeWidth runes wide once the caller right-aligns it; the
// trailing character is a sign placeholder (" " for credits, "-" for Dutch
// debits) or the closing parenthesis for American debits.
func formatChange(currency, locale string, cents int) string {
	negative := cents < 0
	if negative {
		cents = -cents
	}

	whole := cents / 100
	frac := cents % 100
	symbol := currencySymbol(currency)

	if locale == "nl-NL" {
		s := symbol + " " + groupDigits(whole, ".") + "," + twoDigits(frac)
		if negative {
			return s + "-"
		}
		return s + " "
	}

	// en-US
	amount := symbol + groupDigits(whole, ",") + "." + twoDigits(frac)
	if negative {
		return "(" + amount + ")"
	}
	return amount + " "
}

func currencySymbol(currency string) string {
	if currency == "EUR" {
		return "€"
	}
	return "$"
}

// groupDigits inserts sep as a thousands separator, e.g. groupDigits(12345, ".")
// -> "12.345".
func groupDigits(n int, sep string) string {
	s := strconv.Itoa(n)
	var b strings.Builder
	for i, r := range s {
		if i > 0 && (len(s)-i)%3 == 0 {
			b.WriteString(sep)
		}
		b.WriteRune(r)
	}
	return b.String()
}

// twoDigits renders n as a two-digit string, e.g. twoDigits(5) -> "05".
func twoDigits(n int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%02d", n)
}

// padRight returns the spaces needed to pad s up to width. It returns "" when
// s is already at least width.
func padRight(s string, width int) string {
	if len(s) >= width {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.Repeat(" ", width-len(s))
}
```
